evaluation.bootstrap_unit: independent full group, within domain, paired across methods and orders

config.loss: mean unweighted BCE current + mean unweighted BCE one replay group; one optimizer step

memory.replay: Uniform one retained complete group per current update, with replacement
memory.selection: Uniform Algorithm R over unique completed groups, update only after finishing each stage

model.account_pooling: L2-normalize each item embedding, mean all records with multiplicity, L2-normalize account mean
model.input: title + newline + description for each record
model.pair_input: concatenate absolute difference and elementwise product
